spans.s: Khshathrapāvan (IE 8-2, 8-3), Old Persian; ‘a provincial governor.’ See Kṣatrapa.
Khshāyathiya Khshāyathiyānām (IE 8-2), Old Persian; ‘king of kings’; same as Modern Persian Shāhān Shāh. See Basilěos Basilěon, Ṣāhānuṣāhi.

Khshāyathiya vazrka (IE 8-2), Old Persian; ‘the great king’; royal title. It was translated by the Indo-Greek kings in Greek and Prakrit in the legend of their coins and was the original of the Indian royal title Mahārāja. See Basilěos Měgalŏu.
